Pedestal fans used to dry rainwater on UP expressway, draws criticism

Pedestal fans were observed being used to dry rainwater on a section of the Rs 4,200-crore Lucknow-Kanpur expressway in Uttar Pradesh. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav criticized the practice, calling it a "new wind of BJP progress" and mocking the technology. Netizens also reacted, sparking a meme fest online. The use of fans on the expressway, reportedly damaged by rain, has drawn attention and criticism.
